description: Source code for the FPGrowth implementation in Apache Spark MLlib, including classes for the algorithm, model, parameters, and association rule generation.

classes.name: FPGrowth
classes.description: Estimator class for the parallel FP-growth algorithm to mine frequent itemsets.

classes.name: FPGrowthModel
classes.description: Model class representing the result of FPGrowth, including frequent itemsets and association rules.

classes.name: FPGrowthParams
classes.description: Trait defining common parameters for FPGrowth and FPGrowthModel.

classes.name: AssociationRules
classes.description: Object containing methods to generate association rules from frequent itemsets.

methods.name: fit
methods.description: Fits the FPGrowth model to a dataset.

methods.name: genericFit
methods.description: Internal method to perform fitting with instrumentation.

methods.name: transformSchema
methods.description: Validates and transforms the input schema.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the estimator with extra parameters.

methods.name: associationRules
methods.description: Returns the generated association rules based on minConfidence.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms a dataset by applying the model, generating predictions.

methods.name: genericTransform
methods.description: Internal method to perform transformation with broadcasted rules.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Returns an MLWriter for saving the model.
